Blinko is performing imitation behavior: he performs a series of precise and rapid actions, shuttling back and forth along a straight path, similar to the action of bees collecting nectar.

[Question]
What is Blinko possibly imitating?

[Candidate Answers]
A. A dragonfly dancing over a pond
B. A hummingbird hovering near a feeder
C. A robot performing maintenance tasks
D. A bee buzzing from flower to flower
